bugs.what: Exit label read 'go west (toward the east road)' — the direction word and the named destination point opposite ways at a glance (the road is named for its far/Cinderhall-side endpoint), momentarily confusing before arrival clarified it.
bugs.where: Wardmoor West Road -> The East Road

bugs.what: A 'Quest done: The Regent's Writ' completion notice fired on an unrelated later screen (arriving at the Iron Downs east road) instead of at the moment the writ was actually granted by the Marrowgate envoy several turns earlier at Highward.
bugs.where: Iron Downs / The Regent's Writ quest

confusions: Settling the Vale's Hollow King is presented as three parallel options (verses, crown, or steel) with no hint that choosing steel routes you onto a separate 'Hollows burned' progress counter instead of the 'Hollows rested' counter the main six-holds quest text foregrounds -- only learned this distinction later from NPC dialogue at Highward, and it mattered: the Hollow Throne's peaceful 'Fill it' ending explicitly requires rested (not burned) holds.

The outdoor spoil/ridge exploration grid north of Cinderhall (Iron Downs) is large and visually repetitive with little wayfinding signal, so locating the Hundred Gallery entrance and the Flooded Quarry (slag-hound den) took extensive undirected backtracking (~30 turns).
No in-game statement of whether there is a companion/party size cap -- recruited two companions with no pushback, then declined a third and fourth offer without knowing whether a limit existed.
suggestions: Signal early (notice board or the king's own dialogue) that resolving a hollow's grief by combat vs. by rite are tracked on separate counters with different late-game consequences, not just flavor variants of one outcome.
Add stronger directional/landmark hints in the large Iron Downs spoil-heap grid so side objectives aren't found mainly by exhaustive backtracking.
Fire quest-completion notices at the turn the underlying state actually changes, not on a later unrelated screen.
State explicitly whether there is a party size cap for companions.

The pre-ending 'weigh the doors of the seat' preview at the Hollow Throne (which lists every ending's exact requirements) is excellent -- consider surfacing an equivalent low-cost preview earlier for the Vale King and other big branch points.
